metadata.description: Mods for this repo's Claude Code setup.

plugins.name: caveman-mod
plugins.description: Caveman ultracave style: its own output style plus rules injected at session start, every message and every subagent. /caveman off restores your previous output style.

plugins.name: codebase-memory-mod
plugins.description: codebase-memory-mcp for Claude Code: MCP server, skill, and hooks that put the graph first in every chat and subagent, with a gate on grep for indexed code.

plugins.name: rea-mod
plugins.description: REA reverse engineering for Claude Code: MCP server, skill and analysis engines (JDK 21, Ghidra, jadx, Apktool) installed by the mod on first use, kept on rea-agents' latest release.

plugins.name: authentik-mod
plugins.description: authentik 2026.8 management for Claude Code: MCP server with tools for users, groups, SSO apps and providers, flows, policies, RBAC, blueprints, branding and more. URL and token asked at install (token in the keychain), safe by default.

plugins.name: oh-my-context-mod
plugins.description: Routes every plugin and user MCP server through one oh-my-context gateway (bundled, nothing downloaded) and lists skills by name only or hides them behind the gateway (hide_skills), so they stop filling the context while everything still works. Sets itself up on enable and puts everything back on disable or uninstall. /oh-my-context-mod shows what moved and turns it off.

plugins.name: oh-my-agent-mod
plugins.description: oh-my-agent (/oma): DeepSeek-style superagent. Your session becomes a router that never builds: it writes tickets with you, hands each to a worker in its own git worktree with a tester and reviewer, merges, walks the result in Claude Code's built-in browser and fixes small bugs, asking you only for decisions. Sets each project up on first /oma, works alongside oh-my-context.
